text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the day I gave up my New Year's break
to accompany King Halo for her training—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's getting quite noisy, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh, that's not a bad prize at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Especially the destination on that hot spring trip voucher.
If I recall... it should be a first-rate sanatorium.
choice_data_list: You really know your stuff, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, who do you think I am?
I am King Halo, a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that much information
is only. na. tu. ral. for me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And so... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I hereby grant you the privilege of winning the grand prize in my stead!
Now, put your back into it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the full force of her expectant gaze,
I finished shopping in the district
and received one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Out of my own pocket, of course.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You only get one chance, Trainer!
Spin it with everything you've got and aim for the grand prize!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With King Halo's haughty laughter ringing behind me,
I turn the raffle wheel's handle. The result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing!
See, you can do it if you try!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be taking that hot spring ticket♪
There, there, such a good Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring trip ticket was safely tucked away
in King Halo's possession...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now I have one more thing to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a hot springs trip voucher for you and me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...We're both busy right now, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if going to a retreat refreshes my body,
I'm sure my heart will stay restless.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So once everything is finished and settled,
I'll be the one to invite you out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems King Halo
is inviting me to the hot springs trip as well.
choice_data_list: If you'd just told me from the start...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you have a complaint?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the one holding the hot springs ticket right now, aren't I?
Then I believe you know
what kind of attitude you should be taking?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Let's see... First off, wouldn't a 'Thank you so much, King!' be appropriate? Oh-ho-ho-ho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was suddenly hit with regret,
wondering if I'd given them something unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate,
I began to look forward to the day I could truly relax at the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Well, first place
isn't a bad result, is it?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that premium carrot hamburg steak was created by a three-star hotel chef.
The taste is top-notch too.
choice_data_list: You really know your stuff, huh?
You really know your stuff, don't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, didn't I tell you earlier?
I am King Halo, a first-class Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Knowing stuff like this is totally obvious.
Ob-vi-ous♪
choice_data_list: Then you've never even eaten it before?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. Back then, it wasn't chilled, but served at a restaurant though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That was truly delicious, wasn't it?
The moment you took a bite, the oil and tomato sauce
just oozed out... combined with that rich cheese..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...*slurp*

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let us return at once, Trainer.
I will grant you the privilege of cooking for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has a look on her face that says she's dying to eat.
I decided to treat her to hamburg steaks
as soon as we got back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle rustle...!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is... how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A towering mountain of carrots piles up before her.
Even King Halo can't hide the panic on her face—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Whoa, not yet! There's a whole heap left, so here comes another one!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eep!? No way, seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle rustle...!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……They got…… added……
choice_data_list: ...Let's take it home and eat it bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Let's... do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a mountain of carrots brought back home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —When we finished eating it all, King Halo and I exchanged a high five.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just one... Only one single carrot...?
Where did all the lavish prizes go...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This won't do anything more than
a simple post-workout juice...!
choice_data_list: (So you actually cook your own meals...)
(So you actually cook your own meals...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Trainer. Take responsibility and put it in the blender yourself, will you?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Let's head back to the academy quickly.
I expect a juice suitable for a King.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the carrots settled into her stomach as homemade juice.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured, Trainer.
I shall pretend I saw nothing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, try again.
While I keep my eyes closed. Come on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, we only had one lottery ticket.
For today, I had to soothe King Halo
and head home...
